capabilities: generate a masonry gallery from a folder of local images
configure layout via YAML options (gutter, radius, sorting, columns)
open a lightbox view by clicking an image
open the original image in a new tab from the lightbox
extras: README warns that galleries of many large photos can slow the app, and that vertical masonry ordering is unreliable; horizontal masonry is recommended when sorting matters.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a folder of local images as a gallery without manually embedding each image.
summary: Renders a masonry-style image gallery from a folder of local vault images via a YAML-configured code block.
